items.title: Upstash Context7 API for Library Documentation
items.description: Context7 is Upstash's documentation API that provides up-to-date library documentation. API endpoint: https://mcp.context7.com/mcp (HTTP MCP). Used for fetching current library APIs beyond training data cutoff. Supports library search and context queries.

items.title: Context7 Skill Installed in Clawd
items.description: Context7 skill created at /home/desktop/clawd/skills/context7/. Includes SKILL.md with workflow, quick reference, known library IDs (ClickUp: /websites/developer_clickup, Next.js: /vercel/next.js, React: /facebook/react). Python script uses mcporter MCP backend for search and context queries.

items.title: API Key Configured
items.description: Context7 API key configured: ctx7sk-adbf30ec-dabe-4a6f-83de-d6e03912b517. Added to mcporter config via --header flag. Also installed in Claude Code via 'claude mcp add' command for direct MCP access.

items.title: Dual Integration: mcporter and Claude Code MCP
items.description: Context7 integrated via two methods: (1) mcporter CLI for shell access and Clawd skill usage, (2) Official MCP in Claude Code project for direct tool access. Both use same API key.

items.title: ClickUp API Reference Not Indexed
items.description: Context7's ClickUp library crawl (/websites/developer_clickup) does not include API Reference pages due to JavaScript rendering. Only general docs available. Specific endpoint documentation (Create Doc, Create Page, Edit Page) sourced from community ClickUp MCP server docs instead.
